snippet.title: The 7th Guest Remake - Release Date Trailer [ESRB]
snippet.description:
The iconic puzzle-mystery classic The 7th Guest returns, fully remade with modern technology. Explore a foreboding mansion, solve reimagined puzzles, and uncover its dark secrets.

The 7th Guest Remake will launch on June 4, 2026, for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S, with the Nintendo Switch version following at a later date. The game will be priced at $19.99 / €19,99 / £17.99*.

Owners of The 7th Guest VR on Steam or PlayStation will receive the remake at no additional cost at launch. Likewise, players who purchase it on Steam or PlayStation 5 will gain free access to The 7th Guest VR on Steam VR or PlayStation VR2.

The 7th Guest Remake features reimagined puzzles, newly realized environments, and newly recorded volumetric video performances, bringing the classic haunted mansion and its mysteries to life for a new generation of players.

Wishlist now:
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10019061
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/nl-NL/games/store/the-7th-guest-remake/9ns3ck050b4j
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4491360/The_7th_Guest_Remake
GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/the_7th_guest_remake
Epic Games Store: Coming soon
Nintendo Switch: Coming soon
